up: Find all distinct compounds that are mentioned in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4513141. For each compound, return its ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), and its canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Start from the docs table filtering by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4513141', join to compound_records on doc_id, then join to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and finally left join compound_structures on molregno to optionally retrieve the SMILES. Keep only distinct compounds (by molecule_dictionary.chembl_id) to avoid duplicates. Do not add any extra filters.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id,
    md.pref_name,
    cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4513141';
